new_task.instructions: Does new_user_request begin a NEW task, or continue the task in progress at the end of conversation_so_far? A task is one goal the user is working toward: a feature, a bug fix, a review, an answer to a question, a document. Follow-ups, fixes, clarifications, variants and sub-steps toward that goal belong to it. A new task starts where the user turns to a different goal, even inside the same project or document: a different feature, bug, issue, review or release step, or an unrelated question. Returning to an earlier goal after another one also starts a new segment. Greetings, thanks and small talk belong to the task around them. When in doubt, do not split.

criteria.true: new_user_request turns to a different goal, so a new task begins here.
criteria.false: new_user_request continues the task in progress.

hardware.note: API classifiers run remotely; local hardware only sends requests
